resources.string: An unofficial Telegram client.\nChat at your own pace.
Save a personal note in a chat.\nIt stays on this device.
Preview a template and add it to your draft. You decide when to send.
Switch between your accounts.\nKeep work and personal chats apart.
Use your Telegram chat folders.\nTelegram account limits still apply.
Choose a theme and notifications\nthat suit your day.
CapybaraGram can fill in the phone number from your SIM card. You can deny access on the next screen and enter the number yourself.
